AuthList.description: Authorization list, separated by commas. Permission points are as follows: 1 Allow sub-account to share contract discounts of the main account; 2 Allow main account to view the sub-account's fund balance; 3 Allow main account to allocate and reclaim credit limits for the sub-account; 4 Allow main account to view the sub-account's billing information; 5 Allow main account to assist the sub-account with invoice management.

AuthStatus.description: Authorization status enumeration values. 100: Authorization in progress; 200: Authorization established; 250: Authorization change rejected by sub-account; 300: Authorization change canceled by main account; 400: Authorization revoked.

description: Enterprise financial management provides multi-account enterprise customers with a cloud-based, cross-account solution for integrated business and fulfillment (funds, invoices, billing) management.

AccountAlias.description: Display name, used for page display to clarify account usage scenarios.

CancelInvitation.description: Cancel authorization invitation. false: Do not cancel; true: Cancel. To initiate a new authorization invitation, please cancel the existing one first.

Filiation.description: Main-sub relationship enumeration values. 1: Main; 2: Sub.
